test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate preposition to fill in the blank.

The boy jumped ________ the sofa.
solution:
The correct answer is **"on". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The preposition **"on" **is used to indicate that something is placed or situated above something else
